description: This PHP file defines the 'ProjectTranslateOverviewForm' class, which extends an abstract form processor and implements a form processing interface. It creates a form for translating or editing the overview of a project, including fields like name, subtitle, description, media, motivation, about, goal, related info, social commitment, and URL. It also provides functionality to save form data into the project model, handling validation and language-specific updates.

classes.name: ProjectTranslateOverviewForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating and handling a project overview translation form, including fields for project details and a save method to persist changes.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with fields related to project overview, including title, description, media, motivation, goal, related info, social commitment, and URL, based on the current project model.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the form and updates the project model with the form data, handling language-specific fields and errors.
